findings.title: Fail closed after an individual reservation bound is exceeded
findings.authority: KL-025 Residual implementation boundary requires observed actual above bounds to remain recorded and fail closed for further reservation. Protocol 6.6-6.7 and INV-11 require covered physical requests and enforceable reservation maxima.
findings.body: Reliable actual usage above a reservation maximum is recorded, but no root-level bound-violation state or historical-overrun guard prevents future reservation. reserve_budget only checks settled + reserved + new bounds against aggregate root limits. A root with limits calls=3/tokens=1000 and reserved calls=1/tokens=100 settles verified actual calls=1/tokens=101; a second calls=1/tokens=100 reservation succeeds. This is distinct from exhausting the aggregate root: the claimed per-request upper bound has already been disproven. Both current overrun tests exceed the total root limit and therefore miss this case. The contract currently narrows the packet to an overdrawn-root-only denial.
findings.required_change: Preserve verified actual usage and accounting-only late settlement while atomically recording or otherwise guarding any configured-dimension actual > reservation bound under the owner. Deny further root reservations after that violation even when aggregate limits retain capacity, preserving the failure across request revision/takeover. Add deterministic and migrated service evidence for a below-root-limit individual overrun and update the contract. Retest all required checks on the repaired implementation and obtain fresh SHA-bound reviews.
findings.reproduction: Read-only pure-domain execution on the reviewed source: settle_budget({limits:{calls:3,tokens:1000},reserved:{calls:1,tokens:100},settled:{calls:0,tokens:0}}, {calls:1,tokens:100}, {calls:1,tokens:101}); reserve_budget(result,{calls:1,tokens:100},AccountingIdentity(provider,model,config,price)) succeeds with settled tokens=101 and reserved tokens=100.

review_notes: Fresh independent review read AGENTS, current authority index, the full current KL025/KL024 packets, pr-merge-reviewer/protocol-guardian skills, named Protocol 2/6.1-6.7/8 T5-T8 and DB S01-S04/S27-S32, command owners, lock order, T5/T8, invariants and idempotent-dispatch decision; acceptance scope and repository/planning/ledger contracts; prerequisite KL015 result/integration, KL024 result and required SHA-bound PASS reviews, and M2 PASS closure.

Inspected the complete implementation/test/contract diff. S01 -> S27 -> S31 -> S02 coordination order and trusted post-lock current request/attempt/owner/fence/deadline checks are preserved. Reserve/permit reject stale and terminal authority. Bounded internal CancelUndispatched owns only S27 accounting/S31/S32 with locked RESERVED source, never CancelIntent or generic business writes; the closed 39-command public ingress is unchanged.

The existing PermitDispatch first winner commits DISPATCH_INTENT and S32 with S02/S03/S04 before the service permission escapes the outer transaction. Every preflight and under-S01 replay is historical/non-sendable; another permit key cannot reset or redispatch the reservation. Fake sender PU explicitly instruments commit/release-before-send, rollback, lost ACK, before-send and after-send crashes, SDK retry zero and fresh reservations. DISPATCHED diagnosis and a live provider transport remain outside this task.

UNKNOWN retains all outstanding bounds without fictional actual charges or reset/refund. Cancellation/dispatch both lock-winning orders use actual service contenders and PostgreSQL-observed blocking. Dedicated receipt verification is outside coordination; exact immutable reservation/accounting/actual/provenance identity, expected revision/transition rereads and provider receipt/request reuse checks prevent duplicate accounting. Late settlement modifies only accounting plus ledger evidence after revision/takeover/termination and cannot restore attempt, intent, control, authorization, execution or T6 authority.

Supported integer budget dimensions and strict_money=false are explicit; unknown/negative/unbounded dimensions and strict money claims deny. Root arithmetic covers settled plus all outstanding maxima. The single blocker is the missing fail-closed behavior after an individual verified bound overrun while the aggregate root still has room.

Read all sixteen selected raw packet logs and two supplemental logs. Independent read-only audit matched exact commands, tested SHA, exit code zero, no failed/skipped/deselected required cases, SHA256 registry and committed bytes. Ledger PU3/DC6, planning regression8 and owner regression58 PASS logs are present. Source/tests/contracts are identical from tested337e932 to reviewed2200e13; only task result/evidence changes follow testing. Frozen Protocol/DB/baseline, requirement status and public commands/hosted workflows are unchanged from base.

Planning fixture diff exactly matches HG034 import/helper/assignment allowance; namespace proof checks malformed selectors/SHA before runner access, worktree isolation and reset/cleanup selection. Actual namespace/source evidence records task-owned ledger/planning/regression targets. Historical local full-DB blocker remains historical. Committed clarification requires full unmodified tests/db only on unchanged GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest fresh VM; hosted full database/quality CI and selected-task merge gate remain required before merge.

Task PASS, product requirement PASS, review PASS and MERGED remain separate. No product requirement or production/shadow execution claim is added, no frozen change or SPEC_CHANGE_REQUIRED workaround is needed for the identified implementation gap. No database/Docker commands or source/result/evidence/commit mutation were performed in this review; only this review artifact was written.
